title: Three Children Sitting Outdoors, 1957 B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A classic 1957 black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing three young children—identified on the back as Yvette, Stevie, and Rodney—sitting together on a blanket in an open grassy field. The older boy on the right wears iconic 1950s children's attire featuring dark overalls over a striped long-sleeve shirt. Taken on June 17, 1957, this photograph offers a sweet glimpse into everyday mid-century American childhood and rural or suburban family leisure.
